typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		PaymentType as string,
		ReceiptReason as string,
		PayMethod as string,
		VendorRefId as string,
		SubscriberId as string,
		GroupId as string,
		BillingGroupId as string,
		Amount as decimal(19,19),
		CheckNum as string,
		DepositeDate as timestamp,
		LastModifiedDate as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'exec Refund.AutoRefund_CreateExcelFile ?, ?,?',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SRCOLEDBBOSS
SRCOLEDBBOSS derive({Copy of CheckNum} = toString(CheckNum),
		{Copy of PaymentType} = toString(PaymentType),
		{Copy of SubscriberId} = toString(SubscriberId),
		{Copy of VendorRefId} = toString(VendorRefId),
		{Copy of BillingGroupId} = toString(BillingGroupId),
		{Copy of PayMethod} = toString(PayMethod),
		{Copy of ReceiptReason} = toString(ReceiptReason),
		{Copy of GroupId} = toString(GroupId)) ~> DCNVGENERATEXLS
DCNVGENERATEXLS sink(input(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> DSTXLSGENERATEOP
